description: Fork of exp199 (LUT tph=4096, smooth=False, n_alt=1, descending slowly @ ~2.00). Single change: replace input-only pos embedding with a per-layer pos embedding. Each block has its own learned pos_emb [SEQ_LEN, E] added to the residual stream at the start of the block. Hypothesis: with hard LUT and pair-comparison-based attention, position info gets washed out through deep residuals; refreshing pos info per layer should help the LUT and SDPA see clear positional structure at every depth. Adds 6*512*384=1.18M params. Other settings (nap=6, tph=4096, n_alt=1, smooth=False, n_sparse=32) unchanged.
